root_cause: The max_stts_delta feature (added in commit 9cfc7a2440) introduced accumulation of two independently-growing int64_t DTS trackers (current_dts, corrected_dts) driven directly by untrusted 32-bit file fields, and then performed unchecked signed subtraction between them to derive a 'drift' correction value without validating that the operands stay within a range where the subtraction cannot overflow int64_t.
findings: In mov_read_stts(), when processing the 'stts' (sample-to-time) atom, the code accumulates current_dts and corrected_dts as int64_t values based on attacker/file-controlled sample_duration and sample_count fields.
